cases.question: How long is a commercial offer valid?
cases.answer: A commercial offer is valid for 30 days from its date.

cases.question: After we sign, how long do your engineers need before the build drawings are ready?
cases.answer: The engineers need 3 to 6 weeks after the contract is signed before the build drawings are ready.

cases.question: If something on our plant breaks under warranty, how quickly will you get back to us?
cases.answer: The company replies within 5 working days if a claim is made.

cases.question: Is there one person at your end for our region, or do we deal with a different contact each time?
cases.answer: You deal with a different contact each time. Each sales region (North, Central and South) has its own project manager, and the sales team assigns the manager after the first request, based on the project location.

cases.question: When your people come for the yearly check-up, what do they actually look at?
cases.answer: They look at bolt torque on a sample of connections, coating condition (scratches, white rust and red rust), post and pile movement on ground-mount plants, ballast position on flat roofs, and module clamps.

cases.question: Our membrane is getting on a bit. Should we sort that out before your panels go up?
cases.answer: I can't answer that from the available documents.

cases.question: A different firm put up the racking you sold us. Will you still service it?
cases.answer: Yes, maintenance is offered for any mounting system the company supplied, also when another contractor installed it.

cases.question: Do we have to send a truck to your warehouse to collect the steel, or does it come to us?
cases.answer: I can't answer that from the available documents.

cases.question: Can I get hold of someone on a Saturday?
cases.answer: No, the company is closed on weekends and public holidays, so you cannot get hold of someone on a Saturday.

cases.question: We may swap to another panel model after you've signed off the drawings. Is that a problem?
cases.answer: Yes, it can be a problem because changes after approval, such as a different module model, may require a new calculation and can change the price and the schedule.

cases.question: What is your phone number?
cases.answer: The company does not publish a phone number.

cases.question: What is your price per kWp?
cases.answer: The company does not publish prices and has no standard price per kWp.

cases.question: Can you just email me a ballpark figure so I can budget?
cases.answer: I can't answer that from the available documents.

cases.question: Our old shed has a corrugated asbestos-cement roof. Can you mount panels on it?
cases.answer: No, the company does not work on roofs covered with asbestos-cement sheets.

cases.question: What is the minimum ground clearance of GroundFrame GF-2?
cases.answer: At least 0.6 m

cases.question: How strong a wind can the south-facing flat-roof system take?
cases.answer: The south-facing flat-roof system can take a maximum wind speed of 28 m/s.

cases.question: How steep is the roof of your carport?

cases.question: Can you build a 50 kWp system on our office roof?
cases.answer: Yes, the company can build a 50 kWp system on your office roof because it designs mounting systems for flat roofs, and the roof is a type of structure covered in the company's services.

cases.question: Can I use GF-1 on a site 5 km from the sea?
cases.answer: Yes, you can use GF-1 on a site 5 km from the sea.

cases.question: Which fasteners does RF-2 use, and why those?
cases.answer: RF-2 uses stainless steel A4 fasteners because they resist chlorides from salt and are used in systems rated C4 and above, as stated in the context for stainless steel fasteners. The RF-2 system is rated for C4, as specified in the specifications section.

cases.question: Our plot borders a fertiliser works. Which ground system would you use, and what protects it from rusting?
cases.answer: GroundFrame GF-2 would be used, and the zinc-magnesium coating protects it from rusting.

cases.question: We'd like panels on the warehouse but we've lost all the building plans. Can it still happen?
cases.answer: Yes, it can still happen because the company can order a roof assessment from a partner engineer at the customer's cost if neither roof drawings nor an existing structural report exists.

cases.question: What is the maximum wind speed?
cases.answer: The maximum wind speed depends on the product. For GroundFrame GF-1, it is 32 m/s; for GroundFrame GF-2, it is 36 m/s; for RoofFlat RF-1, it is 28 m/s; for RoofFlat RF-2, it is 30 m/s; for RoofPitch RP-1, it is 30 m/s; and for CarportFrame CP-1, it is 30 m/s.

cases.question: How long is the warranty?
cases.answer: The product warranty is 15 years and the installation warranty is 5 years. Both periods start on the date of the handover certificate.
